facts.en: Earned a diploma in instrumentation at Fictional Silvergauge Institute in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构银量规学院获得仪器仪表文凭。

facts.en: Paid laboratory technician at Fictional Cedarstandard Instruments from 2018-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2018-04 至 2026-08 在虚构雪松标准仪器公司任有薪实验室技术员。

facts.en: Performs assigned bench comparisons for temperature probes using the laboratory’s approved procedure.
facts.zh: 依据实验室获批程序，对温度探头执行分配的台架比对。

facts.en: Records instrument serial numbers, reference-equipment IDs and environmental readings on controlled worksheets.
facts.zh: 在受控工作表上记录仪器序列号、参考设备编号及环境读数。

facts.en: Calculates specified differences in a validated spreadsheet and flags results outside the stated acceptance band.
facts.zh: 在经验证的电子表格中计算指定差值，并标记超出规定接受范围的结果。

facts.en: The authorized signatory reviews results and issues calibration certificates; the candidate prepares the supporting worksheet.
facts.zh: 授权签字人审核结果并签发校准证书；候选人准备支持工作表。

facts.en: Keeps incoming instruments separate from items cleared for return and logs unresolved identification issues.
facts.zh: 将送检仪器与获准退回的仪器分开存放，并记录尚未解决的仪器标识问题。

facts.en: Helped revise the serial-number transcription checklist in 2025-06.
facts.zh: 2025-06 协助修订序列号抄录核对表。

facts.en: Personally compared old and proposed worksheet layouts using 30 fictional test records.
facts.zh: 个人使用 30 条虚构测试记录比较旧工作表与拟议版式。

facts.en: A team note describes roughly 12% fewer transcription corrections after the trial, but the baseline count and observation window are absent.
facts.zh: 一份团队备注称试行后抄录更正约减少 12%，但缺少基线数量及观察时段。

facts.en: The available note does not isolate the checklist’s effect from other changes made during the same period.
facts.zh: 现有备注未将核对表的影响与同期其他变更的影响区分开。

facts.en: Uses controlled worksheets, spreadsheet formulas and a laboratory equipment register.
facts.zh: 使用受控工作表、电子表格公式及实验室设备登记册。

facts.en: Completed internal procedure refresher sessions in 2024-02 and 2025-02.
Reports overdue reference-equipment checks to the laboratory supervisor before starting affected work.
facts.zh: 开始受影响工作前，向实验室主管报告参考设备检查逾期情况。

facts.en: Explains worksheet completion to new technicians under the supervisor’s training plan.
facts.zh: 按主管培训计划向新技术员讲解工作表填写。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Clockfern Makers Club from 2020-01 to 2022-05, organizing donated craft materials.
facts.zh: 2020-01 至 2022-05 在虚构钟蕨创客社做志愿者，整理捐赠手工材料。

facts.en: Built a personal cardboard clock-face model in 2023 for a club display; it had no measuring mechanism.
facts.zh: 2023 年为社团展示制作个人纸板钟面模型；该模型没有测量机构。

facts.en: Enjoys photographing geometric shadows and making paper sundial decorations.
facts.zh: 爱好拍摄几何阴影及制作纸日晷装饰。

facts.en: Maintains handovers listing incomplete measurements, held instruments and worksheets awaiting review.
facts.zh: 维护交接记录，列明未完成测量、暂留仪器及待审核工作表。

facts.en: No authority to approve uncertainty budgets or issue final calibration certificates is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录批准不确定度预算或签发最终校准证书的权限。
